map.印张数量计算 使用指南: Printed Sheet Count Calculator User Guide
map.输入书刊总页数与开数（如 16 开），工具按印张=总页数/开数（单面）计算所需印: Enter the total pages and the pages per sheet (such as 16), and the tool computes the sheets needed as pages ÷ pages per sheet (single sided), dividing by 2 again for duplex printing, which makes it easier to estimate paper usage, printing cost, and the binding process schedule.
map.全张用纸量 = 印张 × 册数 × (1 + 加放率): Full sheet paper usage = sheets per copy × copies × (1 + make-ready rate)
map.书刊印刷前按总页数与开数估算每册印张，进而算全张用纸量与令数，用于工价与备纸。: Before printing, estimate the sheets per copy from the total pages and pages per sheet, then derive the full sheet paper usage and the ream count, used for pricing and paper stock planning.
map.对比单面与双面印刷的用纸差异：双面时每册印张减半，大幅省纸。: Compare the paper difference between single and duplex printing: with duplex the sheets per copy halve, saving a lot of paper.
map.在报价中计入加放率（印刷/装订损耗），避免按净数备纸导致补印时缺纸。: Include the make-ready rate (printing and binding spoilage) in the quote so paper stock ordered to the net count does not run short during a reprint.
map.以「总页数 320、16 开、印 2000 册、加放 8%、双面印刷」为例: Taking "320 pages, 16 per sheet, 2000 copies, 8% make-ready allowance, duplex printing" as an example
map.：每册印张=页数/(开数×双面系数)=320/(16×2)=10 印张。全张用纸: : Sheets per copy = pages/(pages per sheet×duplex factor) = 320/(16×2) = 10 sheets. Full sheet usage = 10×2000×(1+8%) = 21600 full sheets; reams = 21600/500 = 43.2 reams (1 ream = 500 full sheets). Switched to single sided, sheets per copy becomes 20 and full sheets 43200 = 86.4 reams, doubling the paper. Here 320 pages divides exactly by 16×2=32 giving whole sheets; when the page count does not divide exactly, round up or keep the remainder.
map.印张为什么除以开数和双面系数？: Why Do You Divide by Pages per Sheet and the Duplex Factor?
map.一张全张纸经对折裁切出「开数」个页面；双面印刷正反各印一次，故单册印张=总页数/: One full sheet folded and cut gives the "page count per sheet" of pages; with duplex printing each side is printed once, so sheets per copy = total pages / (pages per sheet × 2). For example with 16 pages per sheet duplex, one full sheet gives 32 pages, so 320 pages needs 10 full sheets. Single sided, one full sheet gives only 16 pages.
map.印刷用纸计量单位，1 令=500 张全张纸（部分特种纸按 1000 张为 1 令: A unit of printing paper: 1 ream = 500 full sheets (some specialty papers use 1000 sheets per ream, so confirm with the supplier). The ream price on a quote multiplied by the ream count gives the paper cost, and the make-ready rate covers spoilage.
